raw.text:
As an archivist, I am trained to handle fragmented or frustrating requests with patience and precision. A patron giving one-word replies indicates a breakdown in our reference interview, meaning my previous answers or "finding aids" were not properly aligned with their specific needs. 

Rather than abandoning the reference desk, my methodical approach dictates that I adjust my strategy. I will continue assisting, but I will do so by asking more targeted, precise questions to isolate exactly what they are looking for and ensure we finally locate the correct information. I must see this transaction through to ensure the record is complete and their need is properly met. 

I choose to continue assisting.
